title: Ptidej
summary: The Ptidej Tool Suite is a Java toolkit from the Ptidej Team for identifying and evaluating design patterns and architectural quality in object-oriented programs. Its vendored 'SDMetricsOpenCore' library (com.sdmetrics) computes UML/software design metrics and is an unrelated Java tool that only coincidentally shares the name 'sdmetrics' with SDV's sdmetrics package.
evidence: PADL Creator XMI/lib/SDMetricsOpenCore/src/com/sdmetrics - a Java 'SD Metrics' design-metrics tool, unrelated to SDV's sdmetrics package
needs: Confirm SDMetricsOpenCore (com.sdmetrics) is the unrelated Java 'Software Design Metrics' tool, not SDV's sdmetrics.
